protocol.selection: Single spatial-admission challenger: development score 10/12 versus 8/12 (draws half); strongest control unchanged at 2/4; four audited games reconcile and own execution is clean. Candidate buys one extra quadrant in all development games, so this is timing/menu evidence, not demonstrated three-quadrant scale.
protocol.criteria: Require positive paired whole-seed 95% bootstrap score interval, no aggregate opponent-class score regression, and no unresolved operational regression. Freeze all policy bytes during evaluation.
